title: Per-task pre-routing descriptors v1 (routing-calibration decision 11)
description: A labeled E1 evidence addition: the declared, PRE-ROUTING facts about each task of the executed scenario — the closed #109 §12 task class, the route class derived structurally from the scenario declarations, and the declared file-scope size. Derived at publication from the executed scenario configuration and bound to it by preset_digest. Nothing here is a post-execution outcome; this artifact exists so learned-routing features can never touch the label's ingredients.
